etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Learned borrowing from French galvaniser. By surface analysis, galvano- + -ize. Named after Italian physiologist Luigi Aloisio Galvani (1737–1798).
senses: (loosely, dated) To coat with a layer of metal by electrochemical means.
(figurative) To shock or stimulate into sudden activity, as if by electric shock.
